events.text: You open a mud-cake shop by the well. Business is slow.

effects.log: Still no customers. A duck buys one.
The prettiest mud in the village.

events.text: An old man puts on a shadow puppet show behind a paper screen.

effects.log: Monkeys, dragons, a very brave general.
You see how it works. Magic, but with sticks.

events.text: You build a kite out of paper and bamboo.

fail.log: It lands in a tree. Forever.

choices.text: Help a smaller child fly theirs

effects.log: Their kite flies. They cheer for you.

events.text: You and the other children build a secret base in the bamboo grove.

effects.log: Very serious meetings about nothing.
You can see all the way to the mill.

events.text: Thunder crashes all night and you cannot sleep.

choices.text: Count between the flash and the boom

effects.log: The storm moves away, and you learned how.
It works. Blankets are strong.

events.text: You find a copper coin in the road.

effects.log: The best sweet of your life.
The start of a fortune. (+1 taels)

events.text: You catch a cricket with a beautiful song and keep it in a little cage.

effects.log: It sings you to sleep all summer.
It sings from the grass. You know its voice.

events.text: A game of hide and seek. You find the best hiding place in the village.

effects.log: Nobody finds you. You fall asleep. Everyone panics.
The champion of hiding.

events.text: You fall out of the persimmon tree.

effects.log: A sore bottom and a persimmon.
You get the persimmon.

events.text: The older children tell a ghost story by candlelight.

effects.log: You are very scared.
Two children cry. You are a legend.

events.text: You collect river stones and line them up by colour.

effects.log: A stone dragon along the river bank.
Five skips! A new record.

events.text: You are sick in bed. Someone makes you congee with a salted egg.

effects.log: The best congee in the world.
Two days off. Some guilt.

events.text: Snow up to your waist. You dig a tunnel to the neighbour's house.

effects.log: A tunnel with a window.
Twelve snow soldiers guard the street.

events.text: A crow brings you a button every morning.

effects.log: The crow brings you a ring. You return it to the widow down the road.

choices.text: Keep the buttons in a jar

effects.log: A jar of buttons. A strange treasure.

events.text: A bigger child pushes your friend into the mud.

ok.log: The bully falls in the mud too.

fail.log: You both end up in the mud.

effects.log: Clean friend, dirty bully, good day.

events.text: New shoes! They are too big so you will grow into them.

effects.log: They squeak. Everyone knows where you are.
You fall twice. You love them.

events.text: The rich man's garden has a pond of golden fish.

choices.text: Look at them through the gate

effects.log: They are beautiful. You wonder what they taste like.
The rich man catches you and laughs. He lets you come back.

events.text: A travelling opera troupe comes to town. The painted faces are terrifying.

effects.log: You learn every line of the Monkey King.
You scare your whole family at dinner.

events.text: You learn to count to a hundred and count everything in sight.

effects.log: Too many. You try again tomorrow.

choices.text: Count the rice grains in your bowl

effects.log: Dinner gets cold.

events.text: You get lost in the market on a busy day.

choices.text: Ask a stall owner for help

effects.log: Kind strangers bring you home.
By following the smell of home cooking.

events.text: A travelling sword dancer performs in the square. Every move is perfect.

effects.log: Clumsy, then less clumsy.
She shows you one move. You practise it for a year.

events.text: You are allowed to join the village night watch for the first time.

effects.log: Nothing happens. You feel very grown-up.

choices.text: Tell stories with the other watchmen

effects.log: The best night of your year.

events.text: An uncle offers you your first cup of wine at a festival.

choices.text: Hold the cup politely and give it back

effects.log: It smells terrible. You smile politely.
He drinks it for you.

events.text: Students from a rival school mock your village's martial tradition.

fail.log: You lose, but fight well. They respect you.

effects.log: Mockery needs an audience.

events.text: The teacher asks you to help the younger children with their reading.

effects.log: They adore you.
The fastest readers in the village.

events.text: A merchant offers to take you as an apprentice for his shop.

effects.log: An honest living. You keep it in mind.

choices.text: Refuse; you want the martial path

effects.log: He shrugs. The road calls.

events.text: You run up the mountain behind the village every morning.

choices.text: Keep it up for a year

effects.log: Your lungs are bellows.
A good rest and a good view.

events.text: Everyone says you have a crush on the miller's child.

effects.log: That makes it worse.
The rumour dies in a week.

events.text: A classmate has a martial manual and wants to trade for your lunch for a month.

effects.log: The manual is fake. You are hungry.
He trades it to someone else. It is fake.

events.text: A storm traps a fishing boat near the rocks. The villagers need a strong swimmer to carry a rope.

ok.log: The boat is saved. Your name is on every lip.

fail.log: The current beats you. Someone else makes it.

effects.log: Every hand counts. The boat is saved.

events.text: You get a summer job at the market carrying goods.

effects.log: Strong shoulders and some silver. (+5 taels)
You learn how prices really work.

events.text: You try to meditate for an hour. You last four minutes.

effects.log: Five minutes. Progress.
It works better for you.

events.text: An old hero passes through the village. People bow as he walks.

effects.log: He knows. He winks at you.
'Practise,' he says. 'Every day.' You do.

events.text: You break your arm falling from a roof you should not have been on.

effects.log: It heals straight.
It heals slowly. Your left hand is stronger now.

events.text: The village school holds a poetry contest.

ok.log: You win a brush and some respect.

fail.log: Your poem is about fish. Nobody understands.

effects.log: Fair and kind. Everyone is happy.

events.text: Your friends are sneaking out to watch a fight in the next village.

effects.log: An amazing fight. A long walk home. Big trouble.
They tell you all about it. It sounds amazing.

events.text: An old farmer's cart is stuck in a ditch.

effects.log: He gives you a melon.
Smart. He tells everyone you are clever.

events.text: You notice you are taller than most of the grown-ups in the village now.

effects.log: You look like an adult. Almost.
Your back hurts.

events.text: You borrow money from a friend and forget to pay it back.

effects.log: Friends are better than money. (−2 taels)
Fair, and your friend forgets it happened.

events.text: Lying on the roof, you wonder what your life will become.

effects.log: You fall asleep dreaming of banners.
A house, a garden, a family. It sounds good too.
